# InstancedMesh2 (@three.ez/instanced-mesh)

> Enhanced `InstancedMesh` for three.js with dynamic capacity, per-instance frustum culling, fast raycasting via a dynamic BVH, sorting, per-instance visibility/opacity/uniforms, LOD, shadow LOD and skinning.

Use this library when a three.js scene needs to render and efficiently manage thousands to millions of instances with per-instance control. It is an alternative to `THREE.InstancedMesh`.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @three.ez/instanced-mesh three
```

```ts
import { InstancedMesh2 } from '@three.ez/instanced-mesh';

const mesh = new InstancedMesh2(geometry, material, { capacity: 1000 });
mesh.addInstances(1000, (obj, index) => {
  obj.position.x = index;
});
scene.add(mesh);
```

## Core API

- `new InstancedMesh2(geometry, material, params?)` - `params`: `{ capacity = 1000, createEntities = false, allowsEuler = false, useDistanceForLOD = false, renderer? }`.
- `addInstances(count, callback)` / `removeInstances(...ids)` / `clearInstances()` - dynamic capacity, buffers expand automatically.
- `instances[i]` - `InstancedEntity` (Object3D-like) when `createEntities: true`. Call `instance.updateMatrix()` after transforms.
- `computeBVH({ margin }?)` - build the dynamic BVH to accelerate raycasting and frustum culling.
- `sortObjects` + `customSort = createRadixSort(mesh)` - sort instances to reduce overdraw and render transparency.
- `setVisibilityAt(id, value)` / `setOpacityAt(id, value)` / `setColorAt(id, color)`.
- `initUniformsPerInstance({ fragment: { ... } })` + `setUniformAt(id, name, value)` - per-instance shader uniforms.
- `addLOD(geometry, material, distance)` / `addShadowLOD(geometry, distance?)` - level of detail.
- `initSkeleton(skeleton)` + `setBonesAt(id)` - instanced skinning.

## Key notes

- Requires three.js >= 0.159.0.
- Geometry cannot be shared: if reused across meshes it is cloned automatically.
- Call `updateMatrix()` on an `InstancedEntity` after changing its transform.
- Updating a BVH is expensive; build it once instances are mostly static.
- `capacity` defaults to 1000 and grows automatically.
